key_insight: Learning to predict actions can weaken a world model’s ability to keep generated video aligned with language instructions. problem_solved: How to maintain language–video alignment when extending pretrained video models to jointly predict video and actions conditioned on language.
method: Study cross-modal alignment in world action models that predict both video and actions from language instructions.

impact: The work highlights that adding action prediction may compromise instruction-following in video generation. For practitioners, this motivates evaluating alignment alongside action performance rather than assuming pretrained alignment will persist.
